passive.name: Essence Theft
passive.text: After killing 9 minions or monsters, Ahri heals.After taking down an enemy champion, Ahri heals for a greater amount.

spells.name: Orb of Deception
spells.text: Ahri sends out and pulls back her orb, dealing magic damage on the way out and true damage on the way back.

spells.name: Fox-Fire
spells.text: Ahri gains a brief burst of Move Speed and releases three fox-fires, that lock onto and attack nearby enemies.

spells.name: Charm
spells.text: Ahri blows a kiss that damages and charms an enemy it encounters, instantly stopping movement abilities and causing them to walk harmlessly towards her.

spells.name: Spirit Rush
spells.text: Ahri dashes forward and fires essence bolts, damaging nearby enemies. Spirit Rush can be cast up to three times before going on cooldown, and gains additional recasts when taking down enemy champions.

damage.value: Ahri deals burst magic damage with Orb of Deception’s outward pass and true damage with its return.

winCondition.value: Ahri wins by catching targets on the side and finding angles in teamfights.

spikes.why: Ahri can choose Malignance for a lower ultimate cooldown or Blackfire Torch against melee-heavy teams.
Ahri gains additional Spirit Rush recasts, letting her dash and fire more essence bolts.
